name: Cloudflare DNS
description: Sends DNS zones to Cloudflare. The panel keeps the records, and the plugin makes the zone at Cloudflare the same after each change.

credentials.label: API token
credentials.hint: Give the token the permissions Zone: Read and DNS: Edit. To let the panel add and remove zones, also give Zone: Edit.

credentials.label: Account ID
credentials.hint: Necessary only to add a zone that is not at Cloudflare yet. The ID is on the overview page of a zone.
